external_boundaries.reason: They are outside the new PageStore side-storage owner; output capacity is prepared before authoritative/pixel success where required. This census does not charge a caller's whole object twice.

external_boundaries.reason: No global allocator/RSS interposition qualification. Darwin explicitly owned stacks and measured pthread VM regions are paid; this does not claim opaque framework heaps or portable final exit coverage.

qualification: The final matrix binds actual current sources/runtime; representative tests are entry points or families, not evidence that every allocator site was individually fault injected. Complete global peak/allocator, portable final static teardown and TSAN remain open.
